items.q: She had a couple of people like Baby Laurence or something like that, or some other dancer.

ctx.x: I think through John Hammond she booked us into acts. Kelly's Stable. She was trying to book/ She had a couple of people like Baby Laurence or something like that, or some other dancer.
She had nothing to do with the paper business?
